decisions.choice: Maintainer delivery rides the proven SwarmPocket rail, generalized: merge an app change -> CI builds and publishes the APK to a rolling GitHub release -> cp-1 pulls it within 30 minutes -> the update banner appears on the phone over WireGuard -> one-tap install. The public rolling release doubles as the public sideload channel; the cp-1 puller and banner configuration stay swarm-side so the product keeps zero swarm dependency. First device install is one manual sideload (REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES for self-update); release signing keystore and CI secrets are maintainer-gated.
